about_the_game:
Flaunt is an interactive character and outfit collection game featuring a multiplayer social element, built on a strong foundation for future expansions and updates. The in-game economy is user-driven, with supply fully controlled by the player base.

Card packs offer a streamlined way to obtain higher rarity items, while players can still acquire all game items—except characters—through free random drops and by exchanging inventory items for higher rarity ones.

  • User-Controlled Economy & Fully Tradable Items – everything can be traded or sold on the steam marketplace.

  • Evolving Storefront – the Character Store completely refreshes with each new Tour, introducing exclusive outfits and characters. Once removed, these items can only be obtained through Tour Card Packs or from other players on the marketplace.

  • Random fixed drops

  • Exchange system for higher rarity items

  • Fully animated and interactable characters

  • 7 Unique Characters – each with their unique style.

  • 27 Collectible Outfits – ranging from common, uncommon, rare, epic, legendary, mythical, divine, to divine. With special rarities of premium and limited.

  • 250-Player User-Hosted Chat Lobbies – meet others, show off your characters, and check out their outfits.

Upcoming Update #1 Notes (SEA TOUR)

  • Refresh of store page (6 characters + 2 cardpacks)

  • All debug store page items permanent delisting

  • 6 new characters

  • 6 new outfits

Upcoming Update #2 Notes

  • Blackjack multiplayer

  • Advanced exchange divine reroll via blackjack currency

Flexible Community Driven Planned Future Content

  • Pet companions

  • Character customization

  • Back view for characters

  • Advanced character posing and intractability

  • Male characters

  • Expanded multiplayer modes

  • Custom decorated rooms & furniture placement

  • More character interaction animations

  • A competitive card game where players can wager inventory items

  • Item salvaging for materials or rewards

  • Expanded localization for more regions

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 1909 or higher)
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster.
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible graphics card with up-to-date drivers
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: An idle inventory-based interactable character and outfit collection project featuring a player-controlled marketplace. With regular updates introducing new limited-time characters and outfits, including strong social elements like massively online lobbies and chat capabilities.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Indonesian, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Thai
